comment: Single source of truth for the observability + quality tier (Phase K.4, 2026-05-23; SonarQube moved to Mint 2026-05-29). 'services' are checked on the active (Windows) Docker context by .githooks/check-observability-stack.py and the backend/apps/observability/management/commands/check_observability_health.py session-start ritual. 'remote_services' run on the Mint helper behind the mint-quality Compose profile (docs/specs/fr-mint-quality-tool-placement.md, config/docker-stack-health.json); the pre-commit hook verifies them over the network via their health_url so the Observability-Always-On rule still holds, just on Mint instead of Windows. The dedicated verifier is scripts/check-mint-quality-tools.ps1. glitchtip-init is intentionally excluded because it is an init job that exits after running. See docs/specs/fr-observability-always-on-and-no-deferral.md.
